blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate preoperative subtype classification of renal cell carcinoma (RCC) from contrast-enhanced CT remains clinically challenging because clear cell RCC (ccRCC) and non-clear cell RCC often show overlapping imaging appearances. This study evaluates whether foundation representations reduce reliance on handcrafted radiomics, or whether radiomics remains complementary for interpretable tumour characterisation. We compared radiomics, conventional CNN features, MedicalNet-pretrained features, MedVAE representations, and fusion variants for binary ccRCC classification on KiTS23, reporting area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) with bootstrap confidence intervals and average precision (AP) as a complementary class-imbalance-sensitive metric. We further assessed branch-removal ablation, TCGA/AIMI external transfer, and interpretability using radiomics permutation importance and gate-level analysis. Internally, 3D MedVAE gated fusion achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 82.7% and AP of 92.2%. On the external TCGA cohort, the same model achieved an AUC of 79.5% and AP of 98.9%, although specificity remains uncertain because only two external non-ccRCC cases were available. Gate analysis showed a radiomics-dominant fusion regime, suggesting that foundation representations acted as case-dependent refinement signals rather than replacements for structured tumour descriptors. These findings support radiomics as a complementary and clinically interpretable component of CT-based RCC characterisation in the foundation-model era.
blocks.zh: 精确的手术前亚型分类来自对比增强的CT的肾细胞癌(RCC)在临床上仍然具有挑战性,因为清晰的细胞RCC(ccRCC)和非清晰的细胞RCC经常表现出重叠的成像外观. 本研究评价了基础表现是否减少了对手动放射素的依赖,或者放射素是否仍然是可解释肿瘤特征化的补充. 我们比较了无线电、CNN传统特性、医疗网络预设特性、MDVAE表示以及Kits23二进制CCRCC分类的聚变种、接收器操作特征曲线下的报告区、靴子置信间隔和平均精度(AP),作为补充的类平衡敏感度度测量。 我们进一步评估了分部迁移、TCGA/AIMI外部转移,以及利用放射波纹重要性和门级分析的可解释性。 内部,3D MeDVAE门式聚变达到最佳性能,AUC为82.7%,AP为92.2%。 在外部TCGA组中,同一型号实现了79.5%的AUC和98.9%的AP,但具体性仍然不确定,因为只有两个外部非CCRCC病例。 门分析显示存在辐射-主要聚变系统,表明基础表述是视案例而定的改进信号,而不是结构化肿瘤描述器的替代。 这些发现支持放射学作为基础模型时代基于CT的RCC特征化的可补充和临床解释的组成部分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is a major urological malignancy for which accurate preoperative subtype characterisation remains clinically important. Distinguishing clear cell RCC (ccRCC) from non-clear cell RCC is clinically relevant because histological subtype is associated with prognosis, treatment response, and management decisions. Contrast-enhanced CT is central to renal mass assessment [ 8 , 10 ] , but visual interpretation is limited by overlapping enhancement patterns, acquisition heterogeneity, and difficulty in quantifying intratumoural heterogeneity.
blocks.zh: 肾细胞癌(RCC)是一种主要的泌尿性恶性肿瘤,对此,准确的手术前亚型特征化在临床上仍然很重要. 将清晰的细胞RCC(ccRCC)与非清晰的细胞RCC区分开来,在临床上是相关的,因为组织亚型与预后,治疗反应,管理决策相关. 矛盾增强的CT是肾脏质量评估的核心[8,10],但视觉解释受到重叠增强模式,获取异质性,以及难以量化肿瘤内质异质性的限制.

blocks.en: Radiomics provides structured tumour descriptors by extracting predefined shape, intensity, and texture features from routine CT [ 2 , 21 , 15 ] . CT radiomics has shown promise for distinguishing ccRCC from non-clear cell subtypes [ 18 ] , but remains sensitive to segmentation, acquisition protocol, and feature-selection choices. Deep learning and pretrained image representations offer complementary information, with CNN-based transfer learning explored in renal imaging [ 9 , 13 , 5 ] and foundation representations increasingly used when labelled data are limited [ 3 , 17 ] . This raises the practical question of whether foundation representations reduce the need for handcrafted radiomics, or whether radiomics remains useful as structured and interpretable tumour evidence.
blocks.zh: 放射素通过从例行CT[2,21,15]中提取预定义的形状,强度,纹理特征,提供结构化的肿瘤描述符. CT放射线显示有希望将CCRCC与非清晰的细胞亚型区分开来[18],但仍对分裂,获取协议和特征选择保持敏感. 深入学习和经过预先培训的图像表达方式提供了补充信息,在肾上腺成像中探索了基于CNN的转移学习[9,13,5],在标注数据有限时,基础表达方式被越来越多地使用[3,17]. 这就提出了这样一个实际问题:基金会的表示是否减少了手动放射学的需要,或者放射学作为结构化和可解释的肿瘤证据是否仍然有用。

blocks.en: Interpretability and external transfer are also important for clinical adoption. Post hoc saliency methods can be visually intuitive but weakly coupled to the learned decision pathway [ 1 , 6 , 14 , 4 , 12 ] . In contrast, radiomics features correspond to defined tumour phenotype measurements and can support decision-centric interpretation within fusion models. Meanwhile, internal test performance alone is insufficient to assess robustness, motivating cautiously framed external evaluation under acquisition and segmentation shift.
blocks.zh: 解释性和外部转移对于临床采纳也很重要. 事后的突出方法可以直观地看,但与学到的决定途径[1、6、14、4、12]联系不大。 相比之下,辐射特征与定义的肿瘤酚型测量对应,可以支持聚变模型中以决策为中心的解释. 同时,单靠内部测试业绩不足以评估稳健性,促使在采购和分化转移方面进行审慎的外部评价。

blocks.en: This work investigates radiomics–foundation complementarity for ccRCC versus non-clear cell RCC classification from contrast-enhanced CT. We benchmark radiomics, CNN/MedicalNet features, MedVAE representations, and fusion variants on KiTS23. We further assess TCGA/AIMI external transfer and interpretability using radiomics permutation importance and gate-level analysis.
blocks.zh: 这项工作调查了辐射学 — — CCRCC与非清晰的细胞RCC分类的互补作用。 我们以辐射、CNN/MedicalNet的特征、MDVAE的表示以及KitS23上的聚变为基准。 我们进一步利用放射波射的重要性和门级分析,评估TCGA/AIMI的外部转移和可解释性。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the RCC framework: KiTS23 for internal evaluation, TCGA-KIRC/KIRP/KICH with AIMI segmentations for exploratory external transfer, and radiomics–image modelling with interpretability analyses.
blocks.zh: 图1:RCC框架概览:用于内部评价的KitS23、用于探索性外部转移的TCGA-KIRC/KIRP/KICH和用于可解释性分析的放射模型。

blocks.en: 2.1 Study Cohorts and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 2.1 研究组合和预处理

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarises the overall study design. The internal cohort was derived from KiTS23, a public multi-institutional contrast-enhanced CT dataset with kidney, tumour, and cyst segmentations [ 7 ] . Multifocal cases were excluded to avoid lesion-level ambiguity, and the final task was formulated as binary ccRCC versus non-clear cell RCC classification.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了总体研究设计。 内部组群来源于KitS23,一个公共多机构对比增强的CT数据集,有肾脏,肿瘤,囊肿分化[7]. 为了避免损伤级别含糊不清,排除了多焦点案件,最后的任务被拟订为二进制CCRCC与非清晰的细胞RCC分类.

blocks.en: All CT volumes and masks were reoriented to RAS, resampled to 1.0 mm isotropic spacing, and intensity-clipped to [ − 150,200 ] [-150,200] HU. Image volumes were resampled using linear interpolation and masks using nearest-neighbour interpolation. For each tumour, we generated a zero-margin tumour ROI for radiomics extraction and a tumour-centred ROI with a fixed 12-voxel margin for image-representation learning. When multiple tumour annotations were available, a STAPLE consensus mask was used [ 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 所有CT体积和口罩都重新定向到RAS,重印到1.0毫米的异热带间距,强度凝结到[−150200] [-150200] HU. 图像卷通过线性插值和口罩使用近邻插值重新进行复制。 对于每个肿瘤,我们产生了用于放射提取的零边距肿瘤ROI和以肿瘤为中心的ROI,固定的12伏瑟尔边距用于图像表达学习. 当有多种肿瘤说明时,使用STAPLE共识面具[19].

blocks.en: An independent external cohort was derived from TCGA-KIRC, TCGA-KIRP, and TCGA-KICH. Tumour masks were obtained from the AIMI Annotations initiative, which provides AI-generated DICOM-SEG kidney, tumour, and cyst annotations for NCI Imaging Data Commons collections [ 16 , 11 ] . To reduce segmentation-quality uncertainty, we retained only expert-corrected masks or masks assigned the highest expert quality score. The external cohort was used only for evaluation, and its positive-enriched composition was interpreted as exploratory transfer evidence rather than definitive diagnostic specificity.
blocks.zh: 一个独立的外部群体来自TCGA-KIRC、TCGA-KIRP和TCGA-KICH。 肿瘤口罩来自AIMI说明倡议,它为NCI成像数据常识集提供了AI生成的DICOM-SEG肾脏,肿瘤,以及囊肿说明[16,11]. 为了减少分化质量的不确定性,我们只保留专家修正的口罩或口罩,它们被分配到最高的专家质量分数。 外部组别只用于评价,其正浓性构成被解释为探索性转移证据,而不是明确的诊断特殊性。

blocks.en: 2.2 Radiomics Feature Extraction and Classical Baseline
blocks.zh: 2.2 抽取和古典基线

blocks.en: Radiomics features were extracted from the zero-margin tumour ROI using PyRadiomics [ 15 ] with IBSI-aligned definitions [ 21 ] . Shape features were computed from the original image, while first-order and texture features were extracted from original and Laplacian-of-Gaussian filtered images with σ ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 } \sigma\in\{1,2,3\} using a fixed bin width of 25 HU, yielding 386 initial features.
blocks.zh: 从零边距肿瘤ROI中提取了放射特征,使用PyRadiomics[15] 与IBSI对齐的定义[21]. 形状特性是从原始图像中计算出来的,而一阶和纹理特性是从原始图像和Gausian的Laplacian过滤图像中提取出来的,这些图像带有\\\ { 1, 2, 3}\ sigma\ in\ 1, 2,3\\ 使用25 HU的固定bin宽度,产生386个初始特性.

blocks.en: Robustness filtering removed features with ICC < 0.75 <0.75 , low median absolute deviation, and high pairwise correlation ( | ρ | > 0.95 |\rho|>0.95 ). Correlation-based hierarchical clustering was then used to retain representative features, resulting in a 73-dimensional radiomics representation for fusion models.
blocks.zh: 强度过滤被移除的特性,ICC < 0.75 < 0.75, 中位绝对偏差低, 和高对映相关性( ^ ^ ^ 0.95 > 0. 9rho > 0. 95). 关联的分层组合随后被用于保留具有代表性的特性, 从而形成了聚变模型的73维辐射表示.

blocks.en: For the classical radiomics baseline, the 73-dimensional radiomics representation was defined once from the internal KiTS23 cohort and also used as the radiomics input for fusion models. Classifier-level feature selection, scaling, and SVC fitting were restricted to the internal training data and then applied unchanged to validation, internal test, and external cohorts.
blocks.zh: 对于古典放射素基线,73维放射素代表从内部的KitS23组中一度被定义,也用作聚变模型的放射素输入. 分类级特性选择、缩放和SVC配置仅限于内部培训数据,然后适用于验证、内部测试和外部组别。

blocks.en: 2.3 Image Representations and Fusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 图像表示和融合模型

blocks.en: We compared 3D ResNet-18 trained from scratch, MedicalNet-initialised 3D ResNet-18 [ 5 ] , and MedVAE-based image representations [ 17 ] under the same preprocessing and evaluation protocol. MedVAE was evaluated using both slice-based 2D and volumetric 3D branches. Image-only models passed the extracted representation directly to a classifier head.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了从零开始训练的3D ResNet-18、医疗网初始化的3D ResNet-18 [5] 和基于MDVAE的图像表达方式[17]。 使用切片2D和体积3D分支对MDVAE进行了评估. 仅图像模型将提取的表示直接传递给一个分类器头.

blocks.en: For fusion models, the selected radiomics vector was standardised using training-set statistics and projected to the same latent dimension as the image embedding. We evaluated concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion as representative integration strategies. For gated fusion, given image embedding f img ∈ ℝ d f_{\mathrm{img}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} and projected radiomics embedding h rad ∈ ℝ d h_{\mathrm{rad}}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} , the fused representation was defined as: g = σ ⁡ ( MLP ⁡ ( h rad ) ) , h fuse = g ⊙ f img + ( 1 − g ) ⊙ h rad , g=\sigma(\mathrm{MLP}(h_{\mathrm{rad}})),\quad h_{\mathrm{fuse}}=g\odot f_{\mathrm{img}}+(1-g)\odot h_{\mathrm{rad}}, (1) where ⊙ \odot denotes element-wise multiplication. Larger gate values indicate greater image-branch weighting, whereas smaller values indicate greater radiomics-branch weighting. This design allowed the model to adaptively modulate image features using structured radiomics evidence, while preserving gate values as an interpretable estimate of branch weighting.
blocks.zh: 就聚变模型而言,利用培训统计数据,将选定的放射线矢量标准化,并投射到与图像嵌入相同的潜在层面。 我们评价了凝聚、交叉关注和门式聚变作为有代表性的融合战略。 成闸式聚变,给定的图像嵌入 f img → R d mathrm{img}}\in\ mathbb{R}^{d} 和投射的放射素嵌入 h rad → R d h_{\mathrm{rad}}\in\mathb{R}^{d}, 引信代表的定义是: g = σ (MLP⁡ (hrad)), h 引信 =  g f img + (1− g), g=\sigma (\mathrm{rad)), k=\ → h=\ s=\ s=\ s=\sigma (\mathrm{MLP}(h_{\mathrm{rad))),\odot 表示元素明智的倍增. 较大的门值表明图像分支权重较大,而较小的值表明放射分支权重较大。 这种设计使得模型能够利用结构化的放射学证据来适应性地调制图像特征,同时保留了门值作为对分支权重的可解释估计.

blocks.en: 2.4 Decision-Centric Interpretability
blocks.zh: 2.4 决定-儿童可解释性

blocks.en: We performed two complementary interpretability analyses for the best-performing fusion model. First, radiomics permutation importance was used to quantify feature contribution. Each radiomics feature was randomly permuted across cases while keeping image inputs and all other radiomics features unchanged. The procedure was repeated five times per feature, and the mean decrease in AUC was used as the feature-importance score.
blocks.zh: 我们为最佳核聚变模型进行了两项互补的可解释性分析。 首先,利用放射波纹的重要性来量化特征贡献。 每个放射特征都随机渗透到各病例中,而图像输入和所有其他放射特征保持不变。 该程序每功能重复5次,AUC的平均下降作为特征-重要性分数.

blocks.en: Second, we analysed the learned gate values of the gated-fusion model. For each case, the gate vector was extracted during inference and summarised by its mean value. This analysis was performed on both the internal test set and the external cohort to examine how the model weighted image and radiomics branches during prediction.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们分析了门-聚变模型的学门值。 对每一种情况,在推论中都提取出闸门矢量,并按其平均值加以归纳。 这一分析既针对内部测试组,也针对外部组群,以审查模型加权图像和放射分支在预测期间如何进行。

blocks.en: 3 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验和结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The internal KiTS23 cohort was split at the case level into training, validation, and test sets with fixed proportions of 60%, 25%, and 15%. Model selection used validation AUC. Weighted cross-entropy loss mitigated class imbalance, and image-branch augmentation included random flips, 90-degree rotations, and small affine perturbations; all validation, internal test, and external inputs were processed deterministically.
blocks.zh: 内部的KitS23组在个案一级分为培训、鉴定和测试组,固定比例为60%、25%和15%。 模型选择使用验证AUC. 加权的跨直径损失减轻了类的不平衡,图像分支的增强包括随机翻转,90度旋转,以及小的affine扰动;所有验证,内部测试,以及外部输入都经过决定性的处理.

blocks.en: The primary metric was AUC, with AP, sensitivity, specificity, and other threshold-dependent metrics also reported. Threshold-dependent metrics used a Youden-index threshold selected on the internal validation set and locked for internal test and external TCGA evaluation [ 20 ] . Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals were estimated for AUC, and additionally for AP on the external cohort. The TCGA/AIMI cohort was used only for locked-model transfer assessment.
blocks.zh: 主要的衡量标准是AUC,还报告了AP、灵敏度、特异性和其他依赖阈值的衡量标准。 阈值依赖度的度量衡使用在内部验证集中选定的Youden-index阈值,并锁定用于内部测试和外部TCGA评价[20]. AUC还估计了95%的置信间隔,另外,对外部组群的AP而言。 TCGA/AIMI组只用于锁定型号的转移评估。

blocks.en: 3.2 Internal Performance on KiTS23
blocks.zh: 3.2 KitS23的内部性能

blocks.en: Table 1 summarises the internal held-out test performance. The radiomics SVC baseline achieved an AUC of 74.4%, outperforming both image-only MedVAE branches. Fusion improved performance over image-only models, with 3D MedVAE concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion achieving AUCs of 73.8%, 79.5%, and 82.7%, respectively. The best internal result was obtained by 3D MedVAE gated fusion (AUC 82.7%, AP 92.2%). The stronger performance of MedVAE fusion compared with CNN-based fusion may reflect differences in representation structure rather than pretraining alone, with compact generative embeddings complementing radiomics more effectively than discriminative convolutional features in this limited-data setting. The advantage of gated fusion further suggests that case-dependent modality weighting was more effective than fixed concatenation or cross-attention, where less constrained interactions may be more prone to overfitting. Overall, radiomics remained competitive as a standalone descriptor family and provided complementary information when fused with image representations.
blocks.zh: 表1总结了内部搁置测试的性能。 放射素SVC的基线达到74.4%的AUC,优于两个只显示图像的MDVAE分支. 聚变比仅图像模型提高了性能,3D MeDVAE凝聚,跨视,门式聚变分别达到73.8%,79.5%和82.7%的AUC. 3D MeDVAE门式聚变(AUC 82.7%,AP 92.2%)获得最佳内部结果. 与基于CNN的核聚变相比,MDVAE聚变的性能更强,可能反映代表结构的不同,而不仅仅是预先训练,紧凑的基因嵌入在这种有限数据环境中比歧视性的演化特征更有效补充放射. 入门聚变的优点进一步表明,基于案例的模式权重比固定的调适或交叉意向更有效,因为限制较少的相互作用可能更可能过于适应。 总体而言,放射素作为一个独立描述的家族仍然具有竞争力,在与图像描述结合时提供了补充信息。

blocks.en: Table 1: Internal held-out test performance for ccRCC versus non-ccRCC classification. AUC includes bootstrap 95% confidence intervals; all values are percentages.
blocks.zh: 表1:CCRCC相对于非CCRCC分类的内部搁置测试性能. AUC包含95%的置信间隔;所有值都是百分比.

blocks.en: 3.3 Branch-Removal Ablation of the Best Fusion Model
blocks.zh: 3.3 最佳融合模式的分离

blocks.en: We further performed branch-removal ablation on the best-performing 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model by routing either the image representation or the projected radiomics representation alone through the trained gated-fusion classifier, while keeping all model parameters fixed. As shown in Table 2 , the full fusion model achieved an AUC of 82.7%, whereas image-branch-only and radiomics-branch-only inference reached 60.4% and 52.9%, respectively. This supports radiomics–image complementarity within the trained fusion pathway. These single-branch variants are not independently optimised classifiers, and therefore assess pathway dependence rather than standalone modality performance. The large gap between full fusion and either branch alone indicates that the classifier did not simply rely on a single dominant input, but required joint access to both representation spaces.
blocks.zh: 我们还通过训练有素的门装聚变分类器,将图像表示方式或预测的放射物表示方式单独对最佳的3D MeDVAE门装聚变模型进行切除,同时固定所有模型参数。 如表2所示,全聚变模型实现82.7%的AUC,而仅图像分支和放射分支的推论分别达到60.4%和52.9%。 这在训练有素的聚变路径中支持放射素——图像互补。 这些单分支变体不是独立优化的分类器,因此评估路径依赖性而不是独立模式性能. 完全聚变与任何一个分支之间的巨大差距表明,分类器并不单纯依赖于单一的主导输入,而是需要共同进入两个代表空间.

blocks.en: Table 2: Branch-removal ablation within the trained 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model. AUC is reported on the internal test set.
blocks.zh: 表2:训练有素的3D MeDVAE门式聚变模型内的切除。 AUC在内部测试集上报告.

blocks.en: 3.4 Exploratory External Transfer on TCGA with AIMI Segmentations
blocks.zh: 3.4 利用AIMI分部在TCGA上进行探索性对外转让

blocks.en: Table 3 reports locked-model external evaluation on the TCGA renal cancer cohort with AIMI segmentations. This analysis was intended as exploratory transfer assessment rather than definitive external validation, because the cohort was strongly positive-enriched and contained only two non-ccRCC cases. Therefore, specificity and AUC should be interpreted cautiously, and confusion-matrix counts are reported explicitly.
blocks.zh: 表3报告TCGA肾癌组群的锁定模型外部评价,并附有AIMI分型。 这一分析旨在进行探索性转移评估,而不是确定外部验证,因为这一组人具有很强的正向浓缩度,只包含两个非CCRCC案件。 因此,应谨慎地解释具体性和AUC,并明确报告混淆-矩阵计数。

blocks.en: Table 3: Exploratory external transfer performance on the TCGA cohort with AIMI segmentations. Models were evaluated using locked internal-validation thresholds without external refitting. AUC and AP are reported with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals. All metric values are percentages.
blocks.zh: 表3:带有AIMI分区的TCGA组的探索性外部转移性能. 对模型的评估采用锁定的内部验证阈值,而不进行外部调整。 报告AUC和AP的置信间隔为95%。 所有指标值都是百分比。

blocks.en: Several internally trained models retained high positive-class ranking under TCGA/AIMI domain and segmentation shift. The 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model achieved an external AUC of 79.5% and AP of 98.9%, while MedicalNet gated fusion achieved the highest external AUC of 96.2%. This external ranking should be interpreted cautiously, as the apparent MedicalNet advantage may reflect model robustness under TCGA/AIMI shift but was estimated from only two negative cases. This may indicate that different pretrained representations respond differently to acquisition and segmentation shift, rather than a stable superiority of one model family. High AP values mainly reflect positive-class ranking in a cohort with 95.1% ccRCC prevalence, and the very small number of negative cases limits conclusions about balanced diagnostic performance. These results therefore support exploratory transfer feasibility, but not definitive population-level generalisation.
blocks.zh: 一些经过内部培训的模型在TCGA/AIMI域和分区转移下保留了较高的正排位. 3D MeDVAE门式聚变模式实现了79.5%的外部AUC和98.9%的AP,而MedicalNet门式聚变则实现了96.2%的最高外部AUC. 这种外部排名应谨慎地加以解释,因为医疗网的明显优势可能反映TCGA/AIMI转变下的模型稳健性,但估计只有两个负数。 这可能表明,不同的预先训练过的表述对获取和分化转变的反应不同,而不是一个模范家庭的稳定优越性. 高AP值主要反映了在CCRCC流行率为95.1%的组群中的正级排名,而极少数负数病例限制了对平衡诊断性能的结论. 因此,这些结果支持探索性转移的可行性,但并非确定的人口一级的一般化。

blocks.en: 3.5 Radiomics-Based Interpretability
blocks.zh: 3.5 基于放射的可解释性

blocks.en: To examine which structured tumour descriptors contributed most strongly to the best-performing fusion model, we performed repeated permutation importance analysis on the radiomics branch. Figure 2 shows the top-ranked radiomics features according to the mean decrease in AUC after feature-wise permutation. The most influential descriptors were dominated by texture and heterogeneity-related feature families, including GLDM, GLCM, GLSZM, GLRLM, first-order, and Laplacian-of-Gaussian-derived features.
blocks.zh: 为了检查哪些结构化的肿瘤描述器对最佳的聚变模型贡献最大,我们对放射分支进行了反复的演化重要性分析。 图2显示排位最高的放射物特征,按照特异性穿透后AUC的平均减少数排列. 最有影响力的描述器以纹理和异质相关特征家族为主,包括GLDM,GLCM,GLSZM,GLRLM,一阶,以及Gausian衍生的Laplacian特征.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Top radiomics features ranked by mean AUC decrease after repeated feature-wise permutation. Error bars show variation across repetitions.
blocks.zh: 图 2:顶级放射特征在经过反复的特性偏振后,按平均AUC排名下降. 错误栏显示重复次数的差异 。

blocks.en: These results indicate that the fusion model relied on interpretable descriptors of intratumoural heterogeneity and intensity distribution, rather than only on abstract image embeddings. Because these features are defined radiomics measurements, they provide an imaging-level interpretation of model behaviour. However, they should be interpreted as tumour phenotype descriptors rather than direct histopathological surrogates.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,聚变模型依赖于可解释的肿瘤内异性描述和强度分布,而不仅仅是抽象的图像嵌入. 由于这些特征是定义的放射测量,它们为模型行为提供了成像级的判读. 然而,它们应被解释为肿瘤酚类描述剂,而不是直接组织病理学代孕.

blocks.en: 3.6 Gate-Level Interpretability
blocks.zh: 3.6 门级可解释性

blocks.en: We analysed gate values from the 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model. Each case produced a 512-dimensional gate vector, where larger values indicate greater image-branch weighting and smaller values indicate greater radiomics-branch weighting. The analysis was performed on the internal test set and on the 41-case external TCGA cohort with AIMI segmentations, which contained 39 ccRCC and 2 non-ccRCC cases.
blocks.zh: 我们从3D MeDVAE门式聚变模型中分析了门值。 每个病例都产生了512维门矢量,其中较大的值表示图像分支加权,较小的值表示放射分支加权。 分析是在内部测试组和41个案例的外部TCGA组进行,其中包含39个CCRCC和2个非CCRCC案例。

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 3 , mean gate values were consistently below 0.5 in both cohorts. The internal test set showed a mean gate value of 0.1227 ± \pm 0.0675, while the external cohort showed a similar mean value of 0.1328 ± \pm 0.0619. This indicates that the best-performing fusion model operated in a radiomics-dominant regime rather than using balanced multimodal weighting.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,两个组群的平均门值一直低于0.5。 内部测试集显示平均门值为0.1227 ±\pm 0.0675,而外部组显示类似平均门值为0.1328 ±\pm 0.0619. 这表明,最佳的聚变模式是在辐射控制制度下运行的,而不是采用平衡的多式联运加权法。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Gate-level analysis of the 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model. Each point shows the case-level mean of the 512-dimensional gate vector; higher values indicate greater image weighting and lower values greater radiomics weighting. External class-stratified patterns should be interpreted cautiously due to only two non-ccRCC cases.
blocks.zh: 图3:3D MeDVAE门式聚变模型的门级分析. 每个点都显示512维门矢量的大小写级平均值;较高值表示图像重力较大,较低值表示辐射重力较大. 外部分类批准模式应谨慎解释,因为只有两个非CCRCC案件。

blocks.en: Because the external cohort contained only two non-ccRCC cases, class-stratified gate comparisons on the external cohort should be interpreted cautiously. Nevertheless, the overall gate distribution suggests that the model primarily relied on structured radiomics descriptors, with image representations acting as case-dependent modulation signals.
blocks.zh: 由于外部组群只包含两个非CCRCC案件,因此,应当谨慎地解释对外部组群进行等级级门类比较。 尽管如此,总的大门分布表明,该模型主要依靠结构化的放射素描述器,图像表示作为案例依赖的调制信号.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: This study shows that handcrafted radiomics remains clinically relevant for CT-based RCC subtype classification in the foundation-model era. Radiomics was competitive as a standalone descriptor family, while branch-removal ablation and internal performance indicated that the best 3D MedVAE fusion pathway depended on both radiomics and image representations, supporting complementary rather than substitutive value. Exploratory TCGA/AIMI evaluation suggested transfer feasibility under acquisition and segmentation shift, but the positive-enriched external cohort and limited non-ccRCC cases preclude definitive claims about diagnostic specificity. Gate-level and permutation analyses further showed a radiomics-dominant decision pathway, supporting structured tumour descriptors as clinically communicable model evidence. Larger balanced external cohorts and prospective validation remain necessary before clinical deployment.
blocks.zh: 本研究显示,手动放射素在临床上仍然与基础模型时代基于CT的RCC亚型分类相关. 放射素作为一个独立描述的家族具有竞争力,而分枝清除切除和内部性能表明,最佳的3D MeDVAE聚变途径既取决于放射素,也取决于图像表现,支持补充价值,而不是替代价值。 探索性TCGA/AIMI评价建议,在采购和分化转移方面进行转移的可行性,但外部组群呈正浓性,非CCRCC案例有限,排除了对诊断特殊性的明确主张。 门级和穿透性分析进一步显示,辐射支配性决定路径支持结构化肿瘤描述器作为临床可传播模型证据。 在进行临床部署之前,仍需进行更大的外部平衡组群和预期验证。
